# AgentProbe 🔍 **Agent 可观测性与评估框架** — 让 Agent 的每一步决策可追踪、可回放、可评估。

## Why AgentProbe? LLM Agent 在执行复杂任务时，内部决策过程是黑箱的： | 痛点 | 后果 | AgentProbe 方案 | |------|------|----------------| | LLM 编造数据 | Agent 声称"测试通过"，实际未执行 | **Evidence Chain** — 命令输出自动存档，可交叉验证 | | 调试困难 | 20 步执行才失败，无法定位 | **Trace + Web Dashboard** — 可视化每步输入/输出 | | 无法对比优化 | 换了 prompt 不知道更好还是更差 | **Evaluator** — 自动对比 token、延迟、成功率 | ## Features - **Trace System** — 自动捕获 LLM 调用、Tool 调用、决策分支，生成完整执行链 - **Evidence Chain** — 外部命令输出自动存档 + 元数据记录，杜绝数据编造 - **Web Dashboard** — 深色主题可视化面板，实时查看 Trace 时间线和指标 - **CLI Replayer** — 终端彩色回放 Agent 执行过程 - **Evaluator** — 对比不同 Agent/Prompt/Model 的表现，生成评估报告 - **Zero Dependencies** — 仅使用 Python 标准库（SQLite, http.server） ## Quick Start ```bash git clone https://github.com/leeleelxl/agent-probe.git cd agent-probe pip install -e . ``` ### 1. Trace an Agent ```python from agentprobe.trace import TraceCollector, TraceStore store = TraceStore("traces.db") collector = TraceCollector(store=store) with collector.trace("my_task") as t: collector.record_llm_call( model="gpt-4o", input_messages="What tool should I use?", output_text="Use web_search", token_usage={"input": 50, "output": 20}, ) collector.record_tool_call( tool_name="web_search", args={"query": "python best practices"}, result="Found 10 results", ) print(t.summary()) ``` ### 2. Web Dashboard ```bash python -m agentprobe --db traces.db serve ``` Opens a modern dark-themed dashboard at `http://127.0.0.1:8420`: - **Trace List** — 左侧面板浏览所有执行记录 - **Metric Cards** — Duration, Steps, LLM Calls, Tool Calls, Token Usage - **Execution Timeline** — 可展开的时间线，每步可查看详细输入/输出 - **Auto Refresh** — 每 5 秒自动刷新，实时观测进行中的 Agent ### 3. CLI Replay ```bash python -m agentprobe --db traces.db replay --verbose ``` ### 4. Evidence Chain ```python from agentprobe.evidence import EvidenceChain chain = EvidenceChain("results/exp01") result = chain.capture("pytest", ["pytest", "tests/", "-v"], expected="passed") print(f"Verified: {result.verified}") print(chain.summary()) ``` ### 5. Compare & Evaluate ```python from agentprobe.evaluate import TraceComparator cmp = TraceComparator() cmp.add(trace_a) # Prompt v1 cmp.add(trace_b) # Prompt v2 report = cmp.compare() print(report.to_table()) winner = report.winner("total_input_tokens") print(f"Most efficient: {winner.trace_name}") ``` ### 6. Decorator-based Tracking ```python @collector.track_tool() def web_search(query: str) -> str: return requests.get(f"https://api.search.com?q={query}").text with collector.trace("auto_tracked"): web_search("python agent frameworks") # automatically traced ``` ## Architecture ``` agentprobe/ ├── trace/ # Trace/Span data models + SQLite store + Collector ├── evidence/ # Evidence chain — command capture & verification ├── replay/ # Terminal colorized replayer ├── evaluate/ # Multi-trace comparator & metrics ├── web/ # Web dashboard (built-in HTTP server + single-page app) └── __main__.py # CLI entry point ``` ## Design Philosophy 1. **Zero external dependencies** — Only Python stdlib (SQLite, http.server, dataclasses) 2. **Zero intrusion** — Decorators and context managers, no changes to Agent logic 3. **Evidence-first** — All data traceable to raw output, no LLM hallucination 4. **Lightweight** — Single SQLite file, `pip install` and go > Inspired by the evidence chain mechanism in [SOAR Harness](https://github.com/Sisyphe-lee/SOAR_harness). ## License MIT
